component.name: PS5 PKG Tool
component.summary: Manage, inspect, convert and build PS5 dumps, images and debug packages

description.p: A library manager for PS5 dumps, packages and images with a console-inspired interface. Browse titles with their artwork, inspect trophies, activities, executables and package structure, convert between dump folders and exFAT, FFPKG and FFPFSC images, and build debug packages, all through a resumable task queue.
This is not software for obtaining free PS5 games.
